name: Author Website Templates – Create Writer, Author & Publisher Websites Easily
author: RS WP THEMES

sections.description:
Author Website Templates For Elementor is a powerful WordPress plugin designed to help authors, writers, and book publishers create stunning websites effortlessly using Elementor. This plugin provides custom widgets that enhance your website’s design and functionality, making it easy to showcase books, reviews, author details, and more—without any coding.

🚀 Key Features:

  • ✅ Full-Width Book Slider – Highlight featured books in an elegant, responsive slider.
  • ✅ Book Reviews – Display reader testimonials with star ratings to build credibility.
  • ✅ Book Gallery – Showcase your book collection in a stylish and organized layout.
  • ✅ About Section – Introduce yourself with a beautifully designed author bio widget.
  • ✅ Signup Section – Grow your audience with an engaging email subscription area.

🎯 Why Use This Plugin?

  • Easy to Use – Built with Elementor for a seamless drag-and-drop experience.
  • Responsive Design – Ensures a perfect look on all devices.
  • Optimized for Speed – Lightweight and performance-friendly.
  • Customizable – Adjust colors, typography, and layouts to match your brand.

Perfect for self-published authors, novelists, bloggers, and book marketers, this plugin provides all the essential elements needed to create a professional and engaging author website.

💡 Start designing your author website today with Author Website Templates For Elementor!
sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard

  1. Visit ‘Plugins > Add New’
  2. Search for ‘author-website-templates’
  3. Activate Author Website Templates from Plugins page
  4. Go to the Edit Page With Elementor
  5. From Elementor Widget Area Go to The Author Website Design Widget Section..
